name: Salton Sea

categories.label: VP gained during the game
categories.hint: Exhausted claims, executed contracts, short-term objectives, development-track overflow, research card VP already scored.

categories.label: Total value of action cards in hand ($)
categories.labelVi: Tổng giá trị thẻ hành động trên tay ($)

categories.label: Shares x financial asset value
categories.labelVi: Cổ phần x giá trị tài sản
categories.hint: Sum over corporations of your share count times the VP shown on its financial assets value track.

categories.label: Permanent research cards VP x position
categories.hint: For each permanent-effect card: printed VP times its slot position on your company board.

categories.label: Long-term objectives + Grey Stars
categories.labelVi: Mục tiêu dài hạn + Sao xám
categories.hint: Long-term objectives met (all who meet score) plus 1 VP per Grey Star on completed objective cards, only if development track end is reached.

categories.label: Unexecuted contracts penalty (half VP)
categories.labelVi: Phạt hợp đồng chưa thực hiện
categories.hint: Enter half of the VP printed on contracts still on your company board; subtracted.

categories.label: Drill damage penalty
categories.hint: Enter the VP loss shown at your drill damage indicator position; subtracted.

categories.label: Extraction plant damage penalty
categories.labelVi: Phạt hư hại nhà máy chiết xuất
categories.hint: Enter the VP loss shown at your plant damage indicator position; subtracted.

tiebreakers.description: Highest total value in action cards

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends in the End of the Round phase when the claim deck cannot be refilled or two corporations have closed. Damage penalty amounts are printed on the damage tracks (icons not readable in the text), so they are scorer inputs. Solo/GMI mode not modelled.
